findings.label: First-publish token cannot be package-scoped
findings.detail: README.md:44 requires scoping the granular Actions token to project-adx-0, but the package is not yet on npm (the registry returns E404), so it cannot be selected as a package-specific token resource before the workflow creates it. Document a temporary broader read/write, 2FA-bypass token with immediate post-publish rotation, or a manual first publish followed by a package-scoped Actions token.
